objects.name: Analytic 1700
objects.description: For iOS, detect Exploitation for Client Execution by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Connection Creation via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [com.apple.WebContent or com.apple.imagent process shows unexpected child spawn or memory fault at level=fault in Unified Log — kernel fault in message-processing subsystem is exploit execution signal]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
